goal: Prevent node crashes via std::terminate when disk writes fail while saving block and undo data
Allow the node to log diagnostics and shut down cleanly when storage runs out of space
agreement: Strong support for replacing std::terminate crashes with safer stream error handling (ryanofsky)
Supported after adding explicit flush enforcement and buffer assertions (maflcko)
Supported after encountering the same disk-full bug during testing (w0xlt)
Supported after catching runtime errors rather than broader exceptions (sedited)

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it fixes a crash hazard where failed writes in buffered stream destructors cause std::terminate
Requires explicit flush or discard on error so destructors never throw during exception unwinding

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it prevents abrupt node crashes when disks fill up during block and undo serialization
Ensures storage write failures trigger clean node shutdown and diagnostic logging rather than aborting
